stories.title: Yemen's displaced residents face renewed insecurity as Houthis advance on Aden
body: The Guardian reported on 25 November that residents and aid organisations were preparing to leave as Houthi forces approached Aden. The prospect of further displacement adds to an already severe humanitarian crisis.

stories.title: Germany presses case for defence spending and Ukraine support
body: Addressing parliament on 25 November, Chancellor Friedrich Merz argued that Russian actions threaten European security beyond Ukraine. His assessment accompanies debate on Germany's 2027 budget and continued aid to Kyiv; it is a political assessment rather than proof of future Russian intentions.

stories.title: Nuclear test veterans secure inquiry after decades of campaigning
body: AP reported on 25 November that British Cold War nuclear test veterans had secured an inquiry into alleged harm to their health. The inquiry provides a mechanism for examining evidence rather than a final determination of responsibility.

stories.title: Household energy bills set to rise sharply in January
body: The Guardian reported a 26% increase in the typical annual energy bill to £2,166 from January. The figure is a benchmark rather than a universal bill, which depends on usage.

stories.title: White House proposes new tariffs despite midterm setback
body: The administration announced proposed tariffs on 14 trading partners on 25 November. The proposals face consultation and are not yet implemented. The EU has rejected Washington's account of industrial overcapacity.

stories.title: Incoming Democrats boycott Harvard orientation in solidarity with workers
body: The Guardian reported that 53 incoming House Democrats were boycotting Harvard's orientation in support of striking graduate workers. Their election does not mean they have already assumed office.

stories.title: Pakistan's space partnership with China reaches crewed-flight milestone
body: Reuters reported on 25 November that China's Shenzhou-24 launched with a Pakistani national, the first foreign astronaut in China's crewed programme. This is a milestone in bilateral space cooperation.

stories.title: Meta executives meet Congress amid content moderation dispute
body: Reuters reported on 25 November, citing four people familiar with the matter, that Meta executives held talks with India's opposition Congress party over mounting objections to content restrictions. The talks do not establish that allegations of improper moderation have been proven.

stories.title: US third-quarter growth revised to 4.3% annualised
body: The revised US growth figure, reported on 25 November, coincides with stronger price pressures. The annualised quarterly rate is not year-on-year growth; the data complicate monetary policy decisions.

stories.title: Trade uncertainty compounds technology market volatility
body: Reuters reported on 25 November that tariff proposals compounded a technology-sector selloff, with the VIX up more than 60% during November. Volatility reflects market expectations rather than a forecast of realised losses.

stories.title: Rupee reaches eight-month high as foreign equity investment strengthens
body: Reuters reported that the rupee closed at 92.23 per dollar on 25 November after touching 92.1850. Foreign portfolio inflows into Indian stocks reached $14.28 billion in November, according to the report. Currency performance remains sensitive to oil and capital flows.

stories.title: India–UK investment treaty talks stall over arbitration and taxation
body: Reuters reported that officials see little prospect of a near-term investment agreement, with disputes over taxation and investor access to international arbitration unresolved. The existing trade agreement is distinct from the proposed investment treaty.
